precepts.point: This is something you should have your children say every morning. Put it on your wall so they see that we are a holy people, a special people.

precepts.text: The whole creature, Israel, was fashioned anew, a cloud shadowing the camp and a way through the Red Sea where all the people went defended with thy hand; overshadowing is guiding and defending.
precepts.point: Thy cousin Elisabeth hath also conceived a son in her old age, for with God nothing shall be impossible; also means the same way, and the impossible thing is a barren old woman bearing, not a birth without a father.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

precepts.why:
Luke 1:35 says “the power of the Highest shall overshadow thee”. What does overshadow mean? Wisdom of Solomon shows it: “For the whole creature in his proper kind was fashioned again anew, serving the peculiar commandments that were given unto them, that thy children might be kept without hurt”. The whole creature is Israel, the whole nation that came out of Egypt, made new, serving the peculiar commandments.

“As namely, a cloud shadowing the camp; and where water stood before, dry land appeared; and out of the Red sea a way without impediment; and out of the violent stream a green field: Wherethrough all the people went that were defended with thy hand, seeing thy marvellous strange wonders.”

What did the cloud shadowing the camp do for us at the Red Sea? It led us. It guided us through the Red Sea, and the people went through “defended with thy hand.” That is what overshadow means: to lead, guide and defend.

So when the angel says the power of the Highest shall overshadow Mary, it is not the spirit coming into her and making her pregnant. It is the Lord guiding and defending her, leading her to where she had to go.

precepts.text: As for the ungodly, wrath came upon them without mercy unto the end: for he knew before what they would do. The chapter before goes into the destruction of Egypt, all the plagues that came. But here is what is very telling: he did not show mercy in his wrath, because he already knew what they were going to do.
precepts.point: It is like a director, a screenplay writer. They write the movie, and you show up as the actor. They give you the script and you read it and say, this is a good movie, who am I going to play? Oh, I am going to be the Black Panther. Somebody may be morally torn by playing Killmonger, but Killmonger is actually the good guy. My point is Michael B. Jordan agreed to that role. Chadwick Boseman agreed to that role. Everybody agreed to their role, and then the movie was made and we all watched it and we were cheering, Wakanda forever. The same way, the Lord sat in his council and everyone was given their roles, their tasks. He already knew who was who, who was ordained to be in this womb.
precepts.why:
Ezra says, “And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me. For then every one obeyed.” Before the world was made there was a council, and no one spoke against what was ordained. Christ said, these spirits over here, y’all are the twelve tribes of Israel; those spirits right there, y’all are the Jebusites. No one disagreed. When you are before the creator you are not going to say, no, I don’t want to be the Edomites.

It is like a screenplay writer and a director. You show up as the actor, they give you the script, and you say, this is a good movie, who am I going to play? Michael B. Jordan agreed to play Killmonger; they portrayed him as the bad guy, but Killmonger is actually the good guy. Chadwick Boseman agreed to his role. Everybody agreed to their role, then the movie was made and we cheered, Wakanda forever. The same way the Lord sat in his council and everyone was given their roles and tasks.

Wisdom of Solomon proves he knew beforehand: “As for the ungodly, wrath came upon them without mercy unto the end: for he knew before what they would do.” The chapter before goes into the destruction of Egypt and all the plagues that came. What is very telling is that he did not show mercy in his wrath, because he already knew what they were going to do.

So what Paul said and Peter said, the prophet Ezra says the same: it was ordained before the world was made. Now “the manners of them which are created in this world that is made are corrupted by a perpetual seed”, and the Lord already knew who would be ungodly and dealt with them accordingly.

precepts.text: For in all things, O Lord, thou didst magnify thy people, and glorify them, neither didst thou lightly regard them: but didst assist them in every time and place. Wherever we were, the Lord was always there fighting for us. Even in these last days, the Lord will help us.
precepts.point: Some of you are trying to save your enemy. Imagine back in Egypt, the Lord sends Moses to deliver the children of Israel, and the Israelites are fighting to save the Egyptians. That does not make sense, and it is what is happening today. The problem is many of our people do not even know who their enemy is: the enemy is the powers that enslaved and oppress you, and scripture says all the nations that touched Israel are going to answer for it.

note.label: The Book of the Wars of the Lord

precepts.why:
Wisdom closes the account of the Lord’s wars on Egypt the way chapter 18 described them: salvation for his people and destruction for their enemies. “For in all things, O Lord, thou didst magnify thy people, and glorify them”. In all things the Lord magnified his people, the twelve tribes of Israel.

“Neither didst thou lightly regard them: but didst assist them in every time and place.” God assisted us in every time and wherever we were. The Lord was always there fighting for us, and even in these last days the Lord will help us.

That is why the class went on to Jehoshaphat: “Be not afraid nor dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but God’s.” Don’t be scared of armies and people. Teach and speak the word of God no matter what they threaten you with, because the Lord is always there fighting with you.

When an army surrounded Elisha, his servant cried, “Alas, my master! how shall we do?” Elisha answered, “Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them.” The Lord opened the young man’s eyes, “and, behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha.” Angels just waiting for the word. The same thing will come in the future: agents will surround houses and come for some of you. You cannot see it spiritually, but the Lord and his angels are with us, and the growth of IUIC and of Israel could only be accomplished because the Lord is with us, assisting his people in every time and place.

precepts.text: The whole creature was fashioned again anew, serving the peculiar commandments that were given unto them. The fringes, the beard, and the Sabbath are what separate you, and they were given only to us.
precepts.point: You were called out of darkness to show forth his praise. Nobody puts a light under a bushel. You shine from the front, so it is time to take your places.

note.label: Mindset Of A Leader, Actions Of A King

precepts.why:
Peter calls us “a peculiar people”. What makes us peculiar? Wisdom answers: “For the whole creature in his proper kind was fashioned again anew, serving the peculiar commandments that were given unto them”. The peculiar commandments, the same thing Deuteronomy 4 said, are what separate us. They see the fringes on your garment. They see a beard on your face. They ask why y'all never come out with us on Saturday, and you say I have to keep the Sabbath. The Sabbath, what's that? I thought you said you was Christian. That is what separates you from everybody else.

The commandments “that were given unto them”: all these things were given only to us. That is why 1 Peter 2:9 is talking about the Israelites, not the white man. It is not white Grecians in togas, and the Galatians are not the white man in Turkmenistan. It is talking about you. So many of our brothers and sisters have been destroyed and don't see themselves as a prince, a ruler, a judge, but God says you are all of those things. All the leadership books go back to the Bible, which was given only to us, yet they make billions off leadership conferences while we sit at the bottom.

We must magnify the law: “The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law”. That is each and every one of our jobs, to put the laws of God on a pedestal and stand firm for them. When you do, it automatically puts you in a different position, different from everybody else on the face of the earth, because nobody else is standing firm for the commandments. The way you do anything is the way you do everything; nine times out of ten the cracker over you on the job is no better than you, but you are not doing things according to the commandments.

That separation shows. Our sisters dress modestly while the women in Houston dressed so out of order a dress code had to be put in place. Fifty men reading the Bible on a cruise become the disturbance. They make a man an offender for the word. But we were called out of darkness to show forth his praise. Nobody takes a light and puts it under a bushel, and you don't shine from the back. It is time for all of us to take our places.

precepts.text: Serving the peculiar commandments that were given unto them, that thy children might be kept without hurt: that is the baptism.
precepts.point: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents: so the one Israel tempted in the wilderness was Christ.

precepts.text: Creation itself was fashioned anew to keep the children without hurt; a green field out of the violent stream, and afterward the quails, which come later in the wilderness.
precepts.point: Even the ground testified: where water stood before, dry land appeared, and a green field came up out of the violent stream; grass sprang up at the bottom of the sea for the people to pass.

note.label: Exodus 14: The Salvation of the Lord at the Red Sea

precepts.why:
“the children of Israel walked upon dry land in the midst of the sea; and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.” Even the ground testified. “For the whole creature in his proper kind was fashioned again anew, serving the peculiar commandments that were given unto them, that thy children might be kept without hurt: As namely, a cloud shadowing the camp; and where water stood before, dry land appeared; and out of the Red sea a way without impediment; and out of the violent stream a green field”.

Creation itself was fashioned anew to keep the children without hurt. Where water stood before, dry land appeared, and a green field came up out of the violent stream: grass sprang up at the bottom of the sea for the people to pass. “Wherethrough all the people went that were defended with thy hand, seeing thy marvellous strange wonders. For they went at large like horses, and leaped like lambs, praising thee, O Lord, who hadst delivered them.”

They were still mindful of what was done in Egypt, “how the ground brought forth flies instead of cattle, and how the river cast up a multitude of frogs instead of fishes.” And afterward, when “being led with their appetite, they asked delicate meats”, “quails came up unto them from the sea for their contentment”; that comes later in the wilderness. The Lord who fashioned creation anew for Israel at the sea will save Israel out of this captivity the same way, and that is why the brothers and sisters must have faith in these last days.

precepts.text: As in Egypt, the elements themselves were changed to fight against Israel's enemies.
precepts.point: He did the same thing in Egypt: the elements were changed in themselves to fight for Israel, and here he sends down hailstones to destroy the people again.

note.label: Joshua 10: The Day the Sun Stood Still

precepts.why:
“the Lord cast down great stones from heaven upon them unto Azekah, and they died: they were more which died with hailstones than they whom the children of Israel slew with the sword.” The Most High was up in heaven aiming the hailstones right at the people, and nobody could escape.

He did the same thing in Egypt: “For the elements were changed in themselves by a kind of harmony, like as in a psaltery notes change the name of the tune, and yet are always sounds; which may well be perceived by the sight of the things that have been done. For earthly things were turned into watery, and the things, that before swam in the water, now went upon the ground. The fire had power in the water, forgetting his own virtue: and the water forgat his own quenching nature.”

As in Egypt, the elements themselves were changed to fight for Israel against her enemies, and here he sends down hailstones from heaven to destroy the people again.
